description.en: ESP32 redesign of the smart piggy bank, packaged as a product.
description.sl: Pametni hranilnik, prenovljen z ESP32 in zapakiran kot izdelek.

description.en: Eight-channel solenoid manifold, microcontroller, and a recipe book.
description.sl: Razdelilnik z osmimi elektromagnetnimi ventili, mikrokrmilnik in knjiga receptov.

description.en: Functional 3D-printed buckle with full strength calculation and material trade-off.
description.sl: Funkcionalna natisnjena zaponka s celotnim trdnostnim izračunom in izbiro materiala.

description.en: A 3D-printed whistle tuned to musical A — designed from acoustic first principles.
description.sl: Natisnjena piščalka, uglašena na ton A — zasnovana iz osnov akustike.

description.en: Bridges Gardena quick-connect to G3/4 male threads when the OEM piece breaks.
description.sl: Poveže hitro spojko Gardena z zunanjim navojem G3/4, ko se originalni del zlomi.

description.en: Tile-and-spacer divider set sized parametrically to any drawer.
description.sl: Komplet pregrad, parametrično prilagojen kateremukoli predalu.

description.en: Drop-in replacement for a snapped OEM front-light bracket — no need to buy a new lamp.
description.sl: Neposredna zamenjava za zlomljen originalni nosilec — nove luči ni treba kupiti.

description.en: Stepped cone that connects shop-vac hoses to power-tool dust ports of any size.
description.sl: Stopničast stožec, ki poveže cev sesalnika s priključkom za prah na orodju.

description.en: ESP32 and auger servo dispense a measured portion on schedule, with manual override in the web UI.
description.sl: ESP32 in polžni servo ob določenem času odmerita obrok, z ročnim upravljanjem v spletnem vmesniku.

description.en: ESP32-C3 and a capacitive probe light an LED and ping Telegram when the soil gets dry.
description.sl: ESP32-C3 s kapacitivno sondo prižge LED in pošlje sporočilo na Telegram, ko se zemlja izsuši.

description.en: Reed switch and ESP32 send a Telegram message every time a chosen door opens.
description.sl: Reed stikalo in ESP32 pošljeta sporočilo na Telegram ob vsakem odprtju izbranih vrat.

description.en: DS18B20 inside, ESP32-C3 outside; pushes temperature to a local dashboard and alerts on excursion.
description.sl: DS18B20 v hladilniku, ESP32-C3 zunaj; temperaturo pošilja na lokalno nadzorno ploščo in opozori ob odstopanju.

description.en: ESP32 and an MFRC522 reader unlock a 9 g servo bolt when an enrolled card is presented.
description.sl: ESP32 in bralnik MFRC522 odkleneta zapah s 9 g servom, ko prislonite registrirano kartico.

description.en: Drywall anchor with an embedded M3 brass insert for reusable, removable threaded mounts.
description.sl: Vložek za mavčne plošče z medeninasto pušo M3 za večkratno snemljivo pritrditev.

description.en: Printed dovetail plate that fits standard Arca-Swiss clamps — a backup for when the metal one walks away.
description.sl: Natisnjena plošča z lastovičjim repom za standardne Arca-Swiss objemke — rezerva, ko kovinska izgine.

description.en: Triangular bracket calculated for 15 kg per shelf, printed in PETG with three perimeters.
description.sl: Trikotni nosilec, preračunan za 15 kg na polico, natisnjen v PETG s tremi obodi.

description.en: Custom-fit grip printed in TPU 95A with a knurled pattern for wet-hand traction.
description.sl: Ročaj po meri iz TPU 95A z narebričenim vzorcem za oprijem z mokrimi rokami.

description.en: Edge-mounted clip that keeps charger and headphone cables from sliding off the desk.
description.sl: Sponka na robu mize, ki prepreči, da bi kabli zdrsnili na tla.

description.en: Door wedge with a thumb-screw to dial in the holding force on uneven floors.
description.sl: Zagozd z vijakom za nastavitev sile na neravnih tleh.

description.en: 3M-mounted hook with a wide saddle so the headband doesn’t deform.
description.sl: Kavelj na 3M lepilo s širokim sedlom, da se lok slušalk ne deformira.

description.en: Wall-mounted cleat that wraps blind cords above child-reach height.
description.sl: Stensko držalo, ki vrvico žaluzij navije izven dosega otrok.

description.en: Stepped rack for HSS bits 1.0–10.0 mm with neodymium magnets that stick to the toolbox lid.
description.sl: Stopničasto stojalo za HSS svedre 1,0–10,0 mm z neodimovimi magneti za pokrov kovčka.

description.en: Wall-mounted dock with a hidden cable channel — the phone charges flat against the wall.
description.sl: Stensko držalo s skritim kanalom za kabel — telefon se polni ob steni.

description.en: Two-piece stand with a friction hinge that holds 30°–80° viewing angles.
description.sl: Dvodelno stojalo s tornim tečajem, ki drži kot 30°–80°.

description.en: Two L-shaped feet that lift any 13–16" laptop to eye level.
description.sl: Dve L-nogici, ki prenosnik 13–16" dvigneta v višino oči.

description.en: Direct replacement for a snapped D-shaft knob — saves a €40 service call.
description.sl: Neposredna zamenjava za zlomljen gumb na D-osi — prihrani 40 € za servis.

description.en: 12-slot rack sized to the actual diameters of a mixed Wera/Wiha set.
description.sl: Stojalo z 12 mesti, prilagojeno dejanskim premerom kompleta Wera/Wiha.

description.en: Loose-cable catcher with a magnetic base — pull a cable, the magnet stays.
description.sl: Lovilec kablov z magnetnim podnožjem — kabel potegnete, magnet ostane.

description.en: Slip-on TPU spring that doubles the cable’s life at the brick exit.
description.sl: Nataknjena TPU vzmet, ki podvoji življenjsko dobo kabla ob polnilcu.
